Name: Deku Civil War
Description: Play through a civil war between two Deku Scrub factions.

begin.Name: Seeds of War
begin.Description: The Deku Scrubs have never been united, but now a group of rebel scrubs have attacked! Drive out these traitors and avenge destruction of several towns to earn the respect of the King.

middle.Name: Battle for the Forest
middle.Description: The stronghokd of the rebels has been located. Command your forces, amass an invasion force, and destroy their bases to win, but beware: the murky swamp river may hide enemies from plain sight...

end.Name: Woodtemple Battle
end.Description: The enemy has been pushed back to the Great Temple. Now, we will end this war!
